clue.text: As an afterthought, changes books

parts.note: a postscript, PS, is added to a letter as an afterthought
to change something is to alter it, so changes gives alters

explanation.surface: Someone revises their work at the last minute, tacking on changes.
explanation.definitionFit: Psalters are volumes containing the biblical psalms, so they are a kind of book.

clue.text: Tough material, sort of tan, military type

clue.text: Type of radio check on noise from cow-shed

explanation.surface: Monitoring the mooing from a byre with a wireless.
explanation.walkthrough: A cow's noise is a low, so a count of how often cows low is literally a measure of lowing frequency.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-wave broadcasting uses radio waves of low frequency; frequency also means a rate of occurrence, here of lowing.

clue.text: The Case of Baby Bunting?

clue.text: Element of a simple trick, roughly speaking

clue.text: Periods allowed to settle foreign bills cause Pole trouble

clue.text: Zola's heroine switched initially to Tolstoy's

explanation.definitionFit: Anna Karenina is the title heroine of Tolstoy's novel.

clue.text: Gradual disappearance of old campaigners

explanation.surface: Veterans slowly vanishing from view.
explanation.walkthrough: The song says old soldiers never die, they simply fade away.
explanation.definitionFit: A fadeaway is a gradual vanishing; the old saying has old soldiers not dying but quietly vanishing.

clue.text: Badges gains one in new presentation

taken as written

clue.text: Hair style cut out for oarsmen

taken as written

clue.text: Make item to eat from stylish sketch

clue.text: Buoyant as the solar system

clue.text: Lily's form, for example, is a challenge to other athletes

clue.text: Produce too much to cover up

explanation.surface: Over-producing something serves to hide it.
explanation.definitionFit: To overgrow is to grow excessively, and also to spread over and smother something.

clue.text: Valiantly reminiscent of Falstaff

explanation.definitionFit: Stoutly means bravely and resolutely; Falstaff's portly build makes him stout.

clue.text: Some advise me — sterling for the long term

clue.text: Loving political profession

clue.text: Unlikely sort of attraction?

explanation.surface: A doubtful remark about an improbable romance.

explanation.definitionFit: Magnetism draws together opposite poles, an attraction between unlike things.
